options.label: Protected security-at-create DACL
options.effect: Create the absent exact root with DirectorySecurity already applied, disable inherited access rules, and verify the resulting canonical DACL before any probe.
options.tradeoff: Strongest boundary and avoids an inherited-permission exposure window, but requires a new exact owner authorization for ACL construction and root creation.

options.label: Create then immediately replace ACL
options.effect: Create with inherited permissions and immediately replace the DACL before the probe.
options.tradeoff: Simpler but briefly exposes the root under the broad inherited ACL that caused U3E to fail.

options.label: Manual owner pre-provisioning
options.effect: Require the owner to create and harden the directory outside the bounded attempt, then authorize read-only verification.
options.tradeoff: Avoids automated ACL changes but weakens reproducibility and requires separate manual evidence.

options.label: Abandon F candidate
options.effect: Do not remediate F and return to storage-root selection.
options.tradeoff: Avoids ACL modification but discards a volume that passed capacity and path checks.

options.label: Current process Modify plus SYSTEM and Administrators FullControl
options.effect: Resolve the current process SID in memory, grant it Modify, grant LocalSystem and built-in Administrators FullControl, propagate those rules to children, protect the DACL, and persist only boolean policy results.
options.tradeoff: Least-privilege practical lab policy with recovery access; it is intentionally laptop-local and must become a service identity policy for production.

options.label: Current process FullControl
options.effect: Grant the current process, LocalSystem, and Administrators FullControl.
options.tradeoff: Simpler but gives the interactive account more rights than the probe requires.

options.label: Dedicated service SID only
options.effect: Require a pre-existing H-CAM service identity and grant that identity Modify while retaining SYSTEM and Administrators recovery access.
options.tradeoff: Best production direction, but no exact service identity is currently provisioned or authorized on this laptop.

options.label: Owner supplies explicit identity
options.effect: Pause until the owner supplies an exact local or domain identity for the DACL.
options.tradeoff: Explicit but introduces identity handling and delays the lab binding.

options.label: Absent root required
options.effect: Require F:\HCAM-Quarantine to be absent and create it once with the exact protected DACL; any existing object fails before ACL modification.
options.tradeoff: Most deterministic and avoids taking ownership of unknown content, but a manually created root requires a fresh package.

options.label: Allow empty existing root remediation
options.effect: Permit replacing the ACL of an existing empty, non-reparse root after bounded inspection.
options.tradeoff: More tolerant but changes security on a pre-existing object whose origin is not proven.

options.label: Allow owner-confirmed existing root
options.effect: Use an existing root after a separate owner ownership statement.
options.tradeoff: Adds a manual assertion that is weaker than secure creation evidence.

options.label: Defer root handling
options.effect: Do not define whether an existing root may be changed.
options.tradeoff: No retry package can be safely sealed.

options.label: Exact version path, SHA-256, and cache-only WinVerifyTrust
options.effect: Resolve one documented versioned MpCmdRun candidate from AMProductVersion, require a regular non-reparse file, bind path/version/SHA-256, and require cache-only whole-chain trust verification with no UI or executable invocation.
options.tradeoff: Strongest offline local binding; an unavailable cached revocation or chain result fails closed and still does not authorize a scan.

options.label: Get-AuthenticodeSignature plus hash
options.effect: Use the PowerShell signature cmdlet and SHA-256 for the exact candidate.
options.tradeoff: Simpler, but the package cannot make the same explicit cache-only network guarantee.

options.label: Version and hash only
options.effect: Bind only path, version, and SHA-256 without local trust verification.
options.tradeoff: Reproducible but insufficient to establish publisher trust.

options.label: Defer Defender binding
options.effect: Do not query or bind the Defender binary in the next attempt.
options.tradeoff: Storage may be proven, but the accepted scanner chain remains further from readiness.

options.label: Separate pinned bootstrap and hostile-fixture package
options.effect: Keep ModelScan unavailable in the retry; later prepare a separate package that pins the 0.8.8 wheel hash, dependency lock, isolated tool environment, JSON/exit-code contract, and generated hostile fixtures before any artifact scan.
options.tradeoff: Preserves acquisition boundaries and addresses upstream risk signals, but the next retry cannot complete the scanner chain.

options.label: Install ModelScan during the retry
options.effect: Combine storage remediation, dependency acquisition, installation, and scanner binding.
options.tradeoff: Faster on paper but expands network and supply-chain scope and conflicts with the current no-download boundary.

options.label: Remove ModelScan from the chain
options.effect: Proceed with Defender and the future H-CAM passive inspector only.
options.tradeoff: Contradicts accepted D-P3.6-U3D-002 option A.

options.label: Accept owner-installed ModelScan
options.effect: Trust a manually installed distribution after a version query.
options.tradeoff: Lacks exact dependency, artifact, and installation provenance.

options.label: Storage remediation plus Defender binding only
options.effect: Prepare one new digest-bound attempt for secure root creation, ACL verification, the 4096-byte atomic probe, and read-only Defender binary trust binding; ModelScan and passive-inspector work remain separate.
options.tradeoff: Smallest scope that resolves two observed blockers while preserving the accepted scanner-chain boundary.

options.label: Storage remediation only
options.effect: Retry only root creation, ACL verification, and the atomic storage probe.
options.tradeoff: Lowest scope, but Defender remains unbound.

options.label: Defender binding only
options.effect: Do not recreate the root; query only the Defender candidate and offline trust state.
options.tradeoff: Avoids F changes but leaves storage unbound.

options.label: Combined storage, scanner install, and artifact acquisition
options.effect: Attempt to solve storage, all scanners, dependencies, and model acquisition together.
options.tradeoff: Unacceptably broad and conflicts with the accepted staged, fail-closed lifecycle.
